title: holosteum glutinosum
intro: Holosteum glutinosum, commonly known as Sticky Mouse Ear or Sticky Chickweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Holosteum glutinosum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe and heal wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
